neighbours.label: A space directly followed by a character the tokenizer breaks into raw byte pieces: uncommon emoji and symbols (math, chess, APL), rare Chinese characters, polytonic Greek, most Korean syllables. Quiet when the same character has no space before it (glued to a word, after a bracket, quote or line break, at text start), and for common characters kept as whole tokens (→, ✓, €, 😀, everyday Chinese, ordinary Cyrillic or accented letters).
